tools: Apache Maven 3.9.x (the project has no Maven wrapper; verified with 3.9.12)
commands: cd src && MAVEN_OPTS=-Xmx2g mvn -B -DskipTests -Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true clean package
notes: Single-module Maven project, version 0.2.9-SNAPSHOT at this commit. JDK 8 because the pom compiles with maven-compiler-plugin 2.0.2 at source/target 1.6, which JDK 17 no longer accepts (class files major 50). -Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true skips the attach-javadocs execution; the build also runs its assembly executions (sources, test-sources, bin zip), which are not used. Fixed: vfsjfilechooser2 0.2.9.
